name: Puppeteer
description: Browser automation using Puppeteer. Provides tools for web scraping, taking screenshots, filling forms, and interacting with web pages.
author: Anthropic

tools.name: puppeteer_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a URL in the browser

tools.name: puppeteer_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page or a specific element

tools.name: puppeteer_click
tools.description: Click an element on the page

tools.name: puppeteer_fill
tools.description: Fill out an input field on the page

tools.name: puppeteer_select
tools.description: Select a value in a dropdown element

tools.name: puppeteer_hover
tools.description: Hover over an element on the page

tools.name: puppeteer_evaluate
tools.description: Execute JavaScript code in the browser console
